occasions.recipeTitle: Pomegranate & Ras El Hanout Braised Lamb Shoulder
occasions.cuisine: Middle Eastern · North African · For Two · Scales to 12

swaps.text: butternut squash + chickpeas, same spices at 180°C
salmon, half the ras el hanout, 25 min at 200°C
plain chicken thighs, separate pan, mild braising liquid

phases.name: Prep
phases.desc: Score the lamb deeply all over. Rub entirely with ras el hanout, olive oil and a generous amount of salt. Let the spice crust set before searing.

phases.name: Sear
phases.desc: Brown all sides in a heavy casserole over high heat until a deep mahogany crust forms. This is where the flavour lives — don't rush it.

phases.name: Braise
phases.desc: Add aromatics, stock and braising liquid. Cover tight. The house will fill with something extraordinary.

phases.name: Rest
phases.desc: Out of the oven, uncovered. Skim the fat from the braising liquid. Shred coarsely back into the juices with two forks.

phases.name: Serve
phases.desc: Over couscous with cold Greek yogurt, fresh mint, and pomegranate seeds scattered at the last moment. Serve family-style.

pairings: Bold Moroccan Syrah or Côtes du Rhône
Labneh with za'atar & flatbread to start
